rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments of Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the moderation in headline and core inflation, I must emphasize that the headline CPI of 3.54% is significantly influenced by base effects and volatile food components. With food inflation at 5.42%, we cannot afford to be complacent. The positive output gap of 0.30% and robust GVA growth of 6.80% suggest that the economy has the resilience to withstand the current policy rate. Prematurely shifting to a neutral stance or cutting rates risks unanchoring inflation expectations, especially given the uncertainties surrounding monsoon outcomes and global spillovers. We must ensure that inflation durably aligns with the 4.00% target before considering a change in our policy stance.
